properties.summary: The IAEA, Update 375: “Since late-March, the ZNPP has relied on a single off-site power line, Ferosplavna-1.” The IAEA counts 27 complete losses of off-site power since the war began. Update 376 is listed by the IAEA but its text isn't archived yet, so it isn't read here. Reported by the IAEA; Blackout quotes it and does not assess it.
